characters.name: REBANE REINU
characters.description: Väike oranž rebane, pehme karvaga ja koheva sabaga, kandmas väikest sinist vesti. Tal on suured rõõmsad silmad ja uudishimulik naeratus. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: JÄNES JUSS
characters.description: Väike hall jänes pikkade kõrvadega, kandmas rohelist särki. Tal on sõbralikud säravad silmad ja väike roosa nina. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: REINU KODU LÄHEDAL
locations.description: A cozy forest clearing near a fox burrow entrance, with soft green grass and a small, rustic wooden table and two tiny wooden stools. The burrow entrance is visible in the background, surrounded by some gentle spring bushes. Warm, soft sunlight filters through the trees. Cartoon style.

locations.name: SUUR LOMP METSA SERVAS
locations.description: A wide, clear puddle reflecting the blue spring sky, located in a grassy clearing at the edge of a gentle forest. There are a few small, smooth grey stones near the puddle's edge. Green grass surrounds the puddle. Bright spring sunlight. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: REBANE REINU and JÄNES JUSS are standing together in a cozy forest clearing near a fox burrow entrance, smiling at each other. Soft green grass, a small rustic wooden table and two tiny wooden stools are in the background. Warm, soft sunlight filters through the trees. Cartoon style.

REBANE REINU and JÄNES JUSS are standing at the edge of a cozy forest clearing, looking towards a wide, clear puddle in the distance, both pointing excitedly. Soft green grass, a small rustic wooden table and two tiny wooden stools are to their side. Warm, soft sunlight filters through the trees. Cartoon style.

REBANE REINU and JÄNES JUSS are sitting at the small rustic wooden table in the cozy forest clearing. REINU holds a piece of colorful paper, looking thoughtful. JUSS is looking at the paper with an eager expression. Soft green grass. Warm, soft sunlight filters through the trees. Cartoon style.

REBANE REINU and JÄNES JUSS are sitting at the small rustic wooden table. REINU is holding up a stack of various colorful papers, showing them to JUSS. JUSS is smiling and reaching out for the paper. Soft green grass. Warm, soft sunlight filters through the trees. Cartoon style.

REBANE REINU and JÄNES JUSS are sitting at the small rustic wooden table. Both are intently focused, carefully folding colorful pieces of paper into boat shapes with their paws. Several flat pieces of colorful paper are on the table. Soft green grass. Warm, soft sunlight filters through the trees. Cartoon style.

REBANE REINU and JÄNES JUSS are standing, holding their finished, brightly colored paper boats (two of them) in their paws, smiling proudly. The small rustic wooden table with some remaining paper scraps is visible behind them. They are now at the edge of the puddle location. A wide, clear puddle reflecting the blue spring sky is in front of them, with a few small, smooth grey stones near its edge. Green grass surrounds the puddle. Bright spring sunlight. Cartoon style.

REBANE REINU and JÄNES JUSS are kneeling at the edge of the wide, clear puddle, gently placing their brightly colored paper boats onto the water. The puddle reflects the blue spring sky. A few small, smooth grey stones are near the puddle's edge. Green grass surrounds the puddle. Bright spring sunlight. Cartoon style.

REBANE REINU and JÄNES JUSS are sitting at the edge of the wide, clear puddle, watching their brightly colored paper boats gracefully floating across the water. Their expressions are joyful and content. The puddle reflects the blue spring sky. A few small, smooth grey stones are near the puddle's edge. Green grass surrounds the puddle. Bright spring sunlight. Cartoon style.

REBANE REINU and JÄNES JUSS are standing side by side at the edge of the wide, clear puddle, happily clapping their paws and cheering as their paper boats continue to sail. Their faces are full of delight. The puddle reflects the blue spring sky. A few small, smooth grey stones are near the puddle's edge. Green grass surrounds the puddle. Bright spring sunlight. Cartoon style.

REBANE REINU and JÄNES JUSS are sitting together by the wide, clear puddle, watching their paper boats. They are leaning against each other, laughing softly and looking very happy. The puddle reflects the blue spring sky. A few small, smooth grey stones are near the puddle's edge. Green grass surrounds the puddle. Bright spring sunlight. Cartoon style.
